strategy.title: Prioritize BEST visa companies
strategy.description: Cara Care, Audatic, and Jobgether have explicit immigration support or remote-first policies allowing initial work from Iran. These are the safest visa paths — apply to all three immediately.

strategy.title: Apply to fresh postings within 24 hours
strategy.description: Audatic (7 hours old, 36 applicants), Jobgether (15 hours, <25 applicants), and Flix (2 days old) are the freshest. Early application to low-competition postings dramatically increases interview chances.

strategy.title: Target Python-only or Python-primary roles
strategy.description: 20 of 22 jobs (91%) require Python. Avoid Go-heavy roles (GALVANY, Cresta, ARX Robotics). Focus on FastAPI/Django positions where Hassan's 9+ years of Python is a decisive advantage.

strategy.title: Leverage Berlin + Remote-first positions
strategy.description: 12 jobs are in Berlin or fully remote. Berlin on-site roles (Sunday Natural, Parloa, Audatic, Scope Ratings, lemon.markets) have stronger visa sponsorship. Remote roles (Jobgether, Ebury, Cara Care) allow starting work before relocation.

strategy.title: Apply to high-match fintech/payments roles
strategy.description: Ebury (score 76, tech-agnostic), lemon.markets (score 80, bank-backed), and Scope Ratings (score 72, credit rating agency) align with Hassan's IDEX payment processing and fintech experience. Domain knowledge is a differentiator.

strategy.title: Verify stale postings before applying
strategy.description: Karla (5 months), Mindpeak (4 months), Lumenaza (3 months), and Almetra (2 months) are old. Check if still open before spending application time. Prioritize active and recent postings instead.

strengths.name: Python (9+ years)
strengths.detail: Required in 20/22 jobs (91%). Hassan's primary language with deep expertise in FastAPI, Django, asyncio, and data processing. Core differentiator for roles at Audatic, Cara Care, Sunday Natural, Flix, and lemon.markets.

strengths.name: Django/DRF
strengths.detail: Strong match for 5 jobs (Cara Care score 92, Lumenaza score 72, Sunday Natural score 82, suena energy, EnopAI). Django is explicitly required in healthcare, energy, and e-commerce roles.

strengths.name: FastAPI/async
strengths.detail: Required in 11 jobs (Engelhart, Cirql One, Karla, lemon.markets, exmox, WorkGenius, Parloa, Audatic, The Exploration Company, EnopAI, SOA Experts). FastAPI is the most in-demand Python framework across Berlin startups.

strengths.name: PostgreSQL
strengths.detail: Appears in 15/22 jobs (68%). Hassan's deep PostgreSQL expertise (schema design, optimization, data pipelines) is a strong match for Cara Care, Flix, lemon.markets, Scope Ratings, and Lumenaza.

strengths.name: Docker/Kubernetes
strengths.detail: Appears in 10/22 jobs (45%). Container orchestration experience matches Cara Care (K8s), Parloa (K8s), exmox (Docker/K8s), ARX Robotics (Docker/K8s), and WorkGenius (Docker).

strengths.name: AWS/GCP Cloud
strengths.detail: Cloud experience matches 10+ jobs. AWS appears in Engelhart, lemon.markets, Flix, Venture Up, exmox, Almetra. GCP matches Cara Care. Cloud infrastructure is a baseline requirement for senior roles.

strengths.name: AI/ML background (M.Sc.)
strengths.detail: Differentiator for 5 AI-focused roles: Audatic (speech enhancement AI, TensorFlow), Mindpeak (digital pathology ML), Jobgether (AI/ML developer tools), Cresta (AI-powered CDP), Parloa (conversational AI). Hassan's M.Sc. AI and Claude Code experience stand out.

strengths.name: REST API design
strengths.detail: Appears in 8+ jobs as core requirement. Hassan's API design experience (IDEX invoice microservice, transaction processing) is directly transferable to roles at ARX Robotics, lemon.markets, Ebury, and Scope Ratings.

weaknesses.name: TypeScript/Node.js
weaknesses.detail: Appears in 4 jobs (Parloa, Mobility House, ARX Robotics, Jobgether) but not in Hassan's primary stack. Parloa notes 'willing to learn' is acceptable, but TypeScript proficiency would open more senior roles.

weaknesses.name: Go (Golang)
weaknesses.detail: Primary or co-primary language in 3 jobs (GALVANY, Cresta, ARX Robotics). Hassan has no Go experience. These are hard gaps — GALVANY and Cresta are effectively blocked without Go.

weaknesses.name: German language
weaknesses.detail: Blocked 2 jobs entirely: suena energy (C1 required, Hassan has A2) and EnopAI (B2/C1 required). German proficiency would unlock energy sector roles that are otherwise strong technical fits.

weaknesses.name: React/Frontend
weaknesses.detail: Appears in 4+ jobs (GALVANY, Karla, Flix, Mindpeak) as secondary requirement. Backend-focused roles often still expect basic frontend familiarity. Hassan's frontend skills are not highlighted in resume data.

weaknesses.name: Terraform/IaC
weaknesses.detail: Appears in 3 jobs (Flix, Almetra, Venture Up) as infrastructure-as-code requirement. Hassan has Docker/K8s but Terraform-specific experience is not confirmed.

weaknesses.name: Domain-specific knowledge
weaknesses.detail: Energy trading (suena, Engelhart), aerospace (The Exploration Company), defense (ARX Robotics), and SAP/enterprise (Cirql One) are new domains. While transferable, domain familiarity would strengthen applications.
